topics.name: Physiological Signal Reconstruction and Biomarker Estimation
topics.summary: Models reconstruct or translate imperfect biosignals for noninvasive monitoring. Across PPG, conductance, and fetal sensing, recurring goals are preserving clinically useful temporal structure, normalizing device variation, and estimating physiologically meaningful markers.

topics.name: Aerial Object Detection and Sensor Fusion
topics.summary: Aerial-imaging methods address rotated objects, clutter, and poor visibility through orientation-aware detection, text-conditioned queries, and RGB-infrared feature fusion. Multi-scale representations help retain fine targets while suppressing sensor noise.

topics.name: Video Object Tracking and Re-Identification
topics.summary: Tracking systems combine open-vocabulary queries, segment propagation, cross-view features, and scalable association to preserve identities through occlusion, viewpoint changes, and crowded scenes. Benchmarks span UAV footage, vehicle cameras, and long insect videos.

topics.name: Federated Learning for Heterogeneous Edge Systems
topics.summary: Federated edge methods personalize model capacity and initialization for clients with unequal compute, latency, and label access. Device-aware inference budgets and public-to-private transfer improve industrial recognition without centralizing raw data.

topics.name: Video Diffusion and Temporal Generation
topics.summary: Video-generation methods add rendered lighting targets, spectral or on-policy guidance, temporal tokens, and bidirectional context to control appearance and stabilize long rollouts. Applications include relighting, autoregressive synthesis, event reconstruction, interpolation, and drift reduction.

topics.name: Reliable Engineering of LLM Agents and Program Synthesis
topics.summary: Agent and authoring systems use versioned tools, workflow records, procedural retrieval, static invariants, and coverage-aware supervision to turn open-ended generation into checkable artifacts. Results target repository consistency, deeper test generation, and reproducible edits to code or 3D assets.

topics.name: Uncertainty and Faithfulness of Foundation Models
topics.summary: Analyses of language and vision-language models compare confidence, agreement, hidden-state signals, graph structure, and reasoning entropy as indicators of correctness. Calibration, independent checking, and selective routing help expose unfaithful explanations and reduce unsafe generation.

topics.name: Efficient LLM Inference and Memory Management
topics.summary: Serving studies optimize KV retention, session placement, cache reuse, batching, expert activation, draft-tree decoding, model routing, and sampler behavior. Across throughput and quality tests, memory policy and implementation details can matter as much as nominal parameter savings, especially for long contexts.

topics.name: Language Model Compression and Scaling
topics.summary: Compression and scaling methods alter layers, weights, or low-rank updates to obtain smaller or intermediate language models. Pruning and quantization results show that hardware kernels and downstream decisions can diverge from parameter counts or perplexity, motivating deployment-aware evaluation.

topics.name: Language Model Distillation and Specialization
topics.summary: Distillation studies transfer coding, SQL, and structured-text abilities through synthetic traces, parameter-efficient tuning, and verifiable reinforcement signals. Student performance depends on the quality and style of supervision, with teacher size alone failing to predict which capabilities survive.

topics.name: Security and Privacy for Language-Model Agents
topics.summary: Defenses for model and web-agent deployments inspect outputs, prompts, retrieved pages, memory, and tool traffic, while capability controls and forensic attribution trace or disable unsafe behavior. The recurring design is layered semantic filtering with measurable leakage, attack, and utility tradeoffs.

topics.name: Uncertainty-Aware Clinical Imaging
topics.summary: Clinical imaging methods pair diagnostic or segmentation outputs with calibrated uncertainty, rejection options, and cross-scanner validation. Retinal OCT studies use expert disagreement and distribution-shift tests to identify cases that require review.

topics.name: Large Language Models for Education
topics.summary: Education-oriented studies examine Bloom-controlled task difficulty, proposition-level reasoning, classroom use, and public learning discourse through benchmarks, usage logs, and randomized evidence. Benefits are strongest when models support explanation and information seeking, while effortless output generation can reduce reflection.

topics.name: Ordinal Representation Learning
topics.summary: Ordinal predictors represent labels as neighborhoods or distance-weighted relations rather than unrelated classes. Multi-rank uncertainty modeling and batch contrastive objectives improve robustness to annotation ambiguity and preserve ordering across image and video assessment tasks.

topics.name: Speech and Audio Representation Learning
topics.summary: Audio systems span source separation, lip reading, contextual recognition, synthetic dialogue, and interpretable spoof detection, using weak labels, diarization, timing controls, latent factorization, and phoneme-level evidence. Structured acoustic cues improve robustness and inspection across noisy or generated speech.

topics.name: Wireless Sensing and Network Intelligence
topics.summary: RF and wireless-network models combine physical signal views, radar geometry, self-supervised prediction, and environment-aware multimodal features. Applications include modulation recognition, localization, beam selection, and proactive handover under changing channels and incomplete sensing.

topics.name: Scientific Machine Learning and Interpretable Discovery
topics.summary: Neural operators and interpretable discovery tools reduce the cost of large physical simulations while exposing usable structure. Learned transforms handle large scientific computations, while symbolic and topological methods recover equations or coordinates checked against scientific data.

topics.name: Test-Time and Continual Adaptation
topics.summary: Deployment-time adaptation learns from unlabeled traces, executable agent harnesses, or continual vision updates, with attention to parameter efficiency and retention of prior skills. The shared challenge is balancing rapid correction against stability and compute limits.

topics.name: Structured Statistical Learning with Partial Observations
topics.summary: Structured statistical methods exploit shared covariance, clustered causal graphs, graphical-model correlations, and informative missingness. Theory and experiments focus on identifiability, recovery, low-dimensional structure, and decision quality when observations or action coordinates are incomplete.

topics.name: Neurosymbolic Visual Reasoning
topics.summary: Visual reasoning systems combine continuous image representations with declarative constraints, energy models, and interactive hypothesis testing. They evaluate relational answers and rule induction, showing where explicit structure helps beyond ordinary label prediction.

topics.name: Security Compliance Verification
topics.summary: Compliance pipelines convert narrative infrastructure descriptions into typed security graphs and schema-valid OSCAL evidence. Source grounding and deterministic comparison make extraction errors visible for audit instead of allowing them to propagate into machine-readable controls.

topics.name: Robot Manipulation Policy Learning
topics.summary: Robot manipulation research combines vision-language-action policies with contact commands, reusable skills, episode memory, human corrections, and first-person demonstrations. Benchmarks and hardware trials test few-shot transfer, perturbation recovery, real-time control, bimanual tasks, and long-horizon tool use.

topics.name: Safe Robot Control
topics.summary: Safety controllers use reach-avoid tubes, analytic wrench rules, recovery-policy corrections, and differentiable scene constraints to manage uncertain dynamics, limited actuation, and collisions. Offline feasibility checks and fast reactive updates preserve smooth motion while handling intervention or changing geometry.

topics.name: Image Enhancement and Color Transfer
topics.summary: Image-editing methods represent appearance with named curves, statistical features, and smooth three-dimensional lookup tables, enabling targeted color adjustment and text-conditioned style transfer. The recurring constraint is changing illumination or style while preserving scene structure and photorealism.

topics.name: Generative Neuroimaging and Clinical Risk Prediction
topics.summary: Latent generative models separate disease progression or subtype variation from stable anatomy, while multimodal and federated predictors combine imaging with heterogeneous cohort information. Evaluations emphasize patient-specific synthesis, survival discrimination, and transfer across institutions or sparse labels.

topics.name: Medical Image Segmentation and Tracking
topics.summary: Methods cover object segmentation and cellular tracking under sparse labels, long-tailed instances, noisy motion, and language queries. Synthetic context-aware examples, flow-based association, and open-vocabulary attributes improve coverage without relying solely on dense manual annotation.

topics.name: Medical Imaging Evaluation and Privacy
topics.summary: Benchmarking and privacy studies compare medical-image models across organs, modalities, institutions, and federated settings, while image disguising is tested for task utility and reconstruction resistance. The findings underscore the need for reliable splits, boundary metrics, privacy analysis, and reproducible protocols.

topics.name: Language Model Evaluation, Benchmarking, and Abstention
topics.summary: Evaluation work builds stress tests, judge audits, validity checks, abstention rules, and sequential sampling procedures for model assessment. Synthetic and naturalistic tasks reveal failures hidden by aggregate scores, while calibrated stopping and construct decomposition make conclusions more defensible.

topics.name: 3D Reconstruction and Dynamic Scene Synthesis
topics.summary: Geometry, depth, deformation, and illumination are modeled jointly across tetrahedral meshes, Gaussian representations, panoramic inputs, and sparse-view sensors. The recurring objective is stable 3D or 4D reconstruction and synthesis when motion, visibility, or capture density makes conventional pipelines brittle.

topics.name: Human-Centered Clinical AI
topics.summary: Studies of medical assistants and high-stakes decision support combine realistic case narratives, explanation and uncertainty displays, symptom-linked guidance, and user evaluations. Findings emphasize that communication, emotional context, and reviewability affect whether clinicians and patients can act safely on model output.

topics.name: Human Motion Generation and Biomechanics
topics.summary: Motion models use aligned skeleton supervision, kinematic constraints, and temporal transformers to predict biomechanical attributes or generate interactive movement from text. Structured body representations improve plausibility and support movement analysis under physical or task conditions.

topics.name: Computational Models of Texture and Symmetry
topics.summary: Texture and mirror-symmetry studies compare transformer, oriented mid-level, and classical descriptors against human or task-specific similarity judgments. Results show that feature scale and architecture matter, while tuned hand-crafted representations can approach deep models at much lower cost.

topics.name: Mechanistic Interpretability of Model Representations
topics.summary: Probing, relocation, geometric measurement, and causal intervention examine how transformer hidden states store facts, types, instructions, concepts, and refusal behavior. Findings distinguish representation presence from usable recall or correction, and show that attention alone is an unreliable explanation of model behavior.

topics.name: Adaptive Information Acquisition and Robust Decision Learning
topics.summary: Adaptive data and decision procedures reduce costly experiments or labels through score-matching design, prediction-powered residualization, variance-aware acquisition, quantile inference, and robust teaching or inverse-control feedback. Guarantees focus on valid intervals, unbiased risk, or stable choices under uncertainty.

topics.name: Computational Financial Research
topics.summary: Financial research systems connect quote-grounded event extraction, memory-guided factor discovery, executable hypotheses, and empirical validation. The methods aim to make textual signals reproducible and to test whether extracted disclosures carry economically meaningful information.

topics.name: Information Retrieval and Document Understanding
topics.summary: Retrieval and document-analysis systems preserve hierarchy, resolve conversational references, generate and verify candidates, and store cross-document relations for later search. Hashing and embedding comparisons clarify when lexical fingerprints survive rewriting and when semantic representations are needed.

topics.name: Security Monitoring of Cyber-Physical Systems
topics.summary: Cyber-physical security methods address changing normal behavior and dormant malicious logic in connected vehicles and industrial controllers. Adaptive detector selection uses operator feedback, while formal model checking supplies counterexamples and verifies trigger-related properties.

topics.name: Generative AI for Chemistry
topics.summary: Chemistry-focused generative systems combine domain constraints, disease-conditioned molecular design, multi-agent data synthesis, and reward-guided search. Evaluation balances validity, novelty, diversity, target affinity, and factual reliability rather than optimizing a single generation score.

topics.name: Multimodal Representation and Reasoning
topics.summary: Multimodal methods align heterogeneous views with contrastive or predictive objectives, combine privileged signals through experts, and retrieve episodic visual context for selective reasoning. Applications range from crystals and network fingerprints to clinical audio and embodied agents, emphasizing transfer when modalities are missing.

topics.name: Egocentric Video Understanding
topics.summary: First-person video benchmarks use gaze, hand-object cues, persistent identity, and temporal activity structure to assess what viewers notice and how actions unfold. Models and datasets move beyond caption fluency toward object continuity and user-relevant descriptions over long interactions.

topics.name: Affective Computing
topics.summary: Emotion and sentiment models preserve annotator disagreement through calibrated objectives, diverse experts, attribution-guided fusion, and uncertainty-aware predictions. Cross-modal evaluations show gains in human-label alignment without collapsing subjective affect into a single hard target.

topics.name: Adaptive Spatiotemporal Monitoring
topics.summary: Operational monitoring combines temporal graphs, spectral or cross-variable dependencies, causal consistency, and reinforcement-learned retraining policies. The methods rewire or update models when drift appears, aiming to lower intervention cost while retaining sensitivity to changing system behavior.

topics.name: Secure and Private Graph Learning
topics.summary: Privacy-preserving graph learning combines decentralized consensus, participant validation, and selective edge perturbation. The studies balance Byzantine resilience and differential privacy against the structural information needed by graph neural networks.

topics.name: Long-Horizon and Controllable LLM Agents
topics.summary: Long-horizon and controllable agents use recursive search, persistent memory, selective reminders, workflow graphs, capability steering, sensor feedback, and lineage records. Benchmarks and live tasks show that sustained context, explicit specifications, and recovery from partial failure remain central to dependable execution.

topics.name: Deepfake Detection and Media Forensics
topics.summary: Media-forensics systems learn residual relations and use provenance-linked, varied forgery datasets with explanatory annotations. Tests emphasize cross-generator transfer, robustness to common transformations, and evidence connecting detection decisions to synthesis artifacts.

topics.name: Autonomous Driving Perception and Planning
topics.summary: Autonomous-driving methods predict maneuver intent and allocate LiDAR or other perception compute under deadlines. Forecasting and anytime scheduling improve proactive behavior and reduce stalls in dense scenes, where latency and safety compete with recognition accuracy.

topics.name: Embodied Navigation and Spatial Reasoning
topics.summary: Embodied navigation studies test cross-view spatial reasoning, world-centered representations, hierarchical planning, latent retrieval, and rollout-guided prompt revision. Real-robot and diagnostic benchmarks expose failures in 3D understanding and show when structured exploration improves transfer.

topics.name: Learning-Augmented Graph Optimization
topics.summary: Learning-augmented graph optimizers use reinforcement learning to select budgeted links and unfolded Riemannian solvers to adapt message passing across distributed phases. Results target better objective values and communication efficiency under changing network or geometry constraints.

topics.name: Music Audio Modeling
topics.summary: Music-audio systems align multitrack MIDI with recordings for transcription evaluation and condition guitar effects on target attributes. Timing, instrument context, and effect type strongly influence performance, motivating benchmarks that preserve production detail.

topics.name: Trustworthy Multi-Agent Decision-Making
topics.summary: Multi-agent decision systems combine mechanism design, planner auditing, and offline equilibrium values for energy markets and pursuit-evasion games. Explicit safeguards can improve coordination and search, but evaluations also reveal sensitivity to incentives, adversarial behavior, and model mismatch.

topics.name: Nonlinear Dynamical Systems and Constrained Optimization
topics.summary: Nonlinear-system methods learn hidden state transitions and disturbances from sequential data, then support filtering, forecasting, or control with stability considerations. Complementary optimization work adds reachability checks and prox-linear augmented Lagrangians with stationarity or KKT guarantees.

topics.name: Sparse Autoencoder Interpretability
topics.summary: Sparse autoencoder studies improve feature interpretability through structured objectives and alignment across random seeds or modalities. Shared latent concepts become easier to compare while reconstruction remains competitive and seed-specific fragmentation is reduced.

topics.name: Quantum and Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning
topics.summary: Quantum and hybrid reservoir models process high-dimensional signals through parallelized circuit simulation or frozen physical dynamics rather than heavily trained variational stacks. Demonstrations cover image classification and phase-transition indicators, emphasizing scalable representations with limited optimization.

topics.name: Privacy-Preserving Facial Vision
topics.summary: Facial-vision methods combine conformal retrieval sets with restoration-robust features and view-consistent 3D perturbations. They seek predictable recognition coverage while limiting unauthorized attribute inference and preserving visible identity or image utility.

topics.name: AI-Assisted Formal Mathematics
topics.summary: Proof-oriented agents produce machine-checked Lean developments and search for counterexamples to mathematical conjectures. Explicit validation, failure review, and repeatability measures distinguish genuinely verified discoveries from plausible but unsupported language-model suggestions.

topics.name: Human-Centered Interactive AI
topics.summary: Human-centered interactive systems study embodied conversational support, accessible text transformation, marker-based AR input, and visual analytics for statistical models. User judgments and task outcomes emphasize cognitive load, responsiveness, interpretability, and usefulness in real workflows.

topics.name: Human-Centered Robotics and Assistive Interaction
topics.summary: Studies of robots and wearable interfaces measure engagement, channel availability, motion comfort, and EMG intent. Across therapy, notification routing, physical interaction, and prosthetic control, the common aim is to adapt machine behavior to human capabilities while preserving timely, intelligible feedback.

topics.name: Distributed Robot Perception and Simulation
topics.summary: Robotic sensing is made more deployable through communication-efficient state fusion and physics-grounded simulation. The paired emphasis is on consistent multi-robot localization and realistic event-camera data for training perception and control when field labels are scarce.

topics.name: AI for Scientific Discovery and Materials Design
topics.summary: AI systems support discovery by reasoning over reaction pathways, generating open-vocabulary material designs, learning transferable crystal representations, and structuring evidence from scientific literature. These approaches connect predictive models to testable hypotheses, inverse design, and provenance-aware knowledge bases.

topics.name: Diffusion Models for Structured Generation
topics.summary: Diffusion models are adapted to structured outputs by learning token order, enforcing spatial layout constraints, preserving classifier-free guidance during quantization, removing targeted concepts, and generating private mobility trajectories. The shared concern is controllable synthesis under domain-specific structure and deployment limits.

topics.name: Specialized Language Modeling and Text Processing
topics.summary: Language systems are tailored to structure, control, and repair specialized text: latent parsing, advertising copy, aspect sentiment, historical OCR, low-resource multilingual corpora, curated pretraining data, and biological knowledge. The papers emphasize domain-aware supervision and reliable transfer beyond generic generation.

topics.name: Tool-Grounded Agentic Workflows
topics.summary: Agentic systems become more dependable when they combine tools with explicit schemas, causal data tasks, structured web retrieval, versioned data operations, trajectory attribution, incident logs, and clarified supervision. Across these settings, grounding intermediate actions makes long workflows easier to verify, audit, and repair.

topics.name: Social Alignment and Multi-Agent Simulation
topics.summary: These studies examine how agents represent social values, inspect learning curricula, simulate household behavior, evolve personas, and experience unequal access to context. Evaluation of intersectional fairness adds a measurement layer for deciding whether agent behavior remains useful across different groups and settings.

topics.name: Learning Theory and Optimization Dynamics
topics.summary: Theoretical and empirical analyses probe why learning succeeds under noisy gradients, large steps, alternative training rules, scheduling choices, and ill-conditioned linear solves. Together they connect convergence, sharpness, numerical stability, and hardware-independent training behavior to practical optimization decisions.

topics.name: Privacy-Preserving Data and Machine Learning
topics.summary: Privacy mechanisms are combined with useful analysis through symmetry-aware clustering, causal synthetic data calibrated to target estimands, and encrypted cloud queries. Each method addresses the utility loss that appears when sensitive records, database contents, or model inputs cannot be exposed directly.

topics.name: Embodied Planning and Vision-Language Control
topics.summary: Embodied agents link language and perception to feasible actions through imagined visual checks, end-to-end driving post-training, write-protected world-model interfaces, dexterous retargeting, bandwidth-aware navigation, and direct VLM-to-VLA transfer. The focus is reliable control under geometry, communication, and data constraints.

topics.name: Low-Light, Image Restoration, and Recognition
topics.summary: Low-level vision methods recover usable structure from difficult imagery using unpaired distribution modeling, low-light enhancement, partial-reference quality assessment, and super-resolution before text recognition. Their shared goal is to improve downstream perception without requiring ideal paired images or clean capture conditions.

topics.name: Retrieval and Grounding for Open-World Perception
topics.summary: Open-world perception systems retrieve or ground visual targets beyond fixed class lists. Multi-interest user embeddings, UAV referring, vector-backed object recognition, and incident-focused dashcam VQA all address how to select relevant evidence when queries, viewpoints, or target categories vary.

topics.name: Physics-Guided Time-Series Forecasting and Anomaly Detection
topics.summary: Time-series models incorporate physical constraints, multiple temporal rhythms, modality-aware routing, and federated Koopman structure. Applications span photovoltaic generation, long-range forecasting, multimodal numerical reasoning, and IoT monitoring, with robustness to regime changes and distributed data as recurring requirements.

topics.name: Audio, Music, and Event-Based Speech Modeling
topics.summary: Audio representations preserve timing and semantic cues for multi-instrument transcription, event-based lip reading, and accessible descriptions of visual memes. The methods exploit fine temporal structure or dialog context to make recognition and non-visual communication more robust.

topics.name: Specialized Visual Recognition and Earth Observation
topics.summary: Visual recognition is specialized for misaligned RGB-thermal video, figure-ground cues, agricultural mapping, and long-tailed aquatic species. These studies use cross-sensor structure, perceptual organization, geographic scale, or hierarchical traits to recognize targets that ordinary category models can miss.

topics.name: Human-Centered AI Evaluation and Bias
topics.summary: Evaluation settings make model behavior more realistic by testing complete psychiatric encounters, theory-flexible personality judgments, and disability stereotypes in text-to-image systems. The papers emphasize task design, human-centered rubrics, and subgroup-sensitive analysis rather than relying on a single aggregate score.

topics.name: Data Analysis, Imputation, and Network Surrogates
topics.summary: Data analysis tools improve scalability, missingness diagnosis, graph-based exploration, and risk estimation in interdependent systems. Distance classifiers, interactive imputation, UMAP neighborhood graphs, spectral embeddings, and cascade surrogates all expose structure that is otherwise costly or opaque to inspect.

topics.name: Efficient Neural Computation and Training Systems
topics.summary: Systems research reduces the cost of neural workloads through differentiable programmable hardware, precision-aware update auditing, and market-based allocation of scarce training accelerators. The common perspective treats throughput, memory, numerical behavior, and resource value as coupled deployment concerns.

topics.name: Interactive Decision and Game Learning
topics.summary: Interactive learning procedures study how agents coordinate with partially informed partners, identify high-ranked options from noisy comparisons, or improve search in sparsely rewarded games. Guarantees and oracle-based evaluations clarify both efficiency and the limits of learned decision policies.

topics.name: Computational Social and Urban Dynamics
topics.summary: Computational studies model how social structure and institutions evolve across science networks, legislatures, community rumor processes, and urban neighborhoods. Historical measurement, community-aware diffusion, and behavioral indicators connect algorithmic analysis to real collective dynamics.

topics.name: Clinical Imaging for Diagnosis and Intervention
topics.summary: Clinical vision systems learn robust representations for pathology grading, distinguish lesion types in brain MRI, and track cardiac motion and catheter position during coronary procedures. Across diagnostic and interventional settings, they address scanner variation, sparse labels, and the need for reliable temporal guidance.

topics.name: Human Sensing and Perceptual Assessment
topics.summary: Human sensing studies infer activity, reading behavior, and affective perception from radar, gaze, and experimentally designed visual stimuli. They focus on generalization across people and environments while making the measured cues useful for accessibility, behavioral science, or non-contact monitoring.

topics.name: Personalized Intervention and Learning Studies
topics.summary: Empirical studies ask when tailoring an intervention is worth its added cost and how fine-grained tutoring feedback changes student responses over repeated interactions. Both emphasize treatment heterogeneity, measurement choices, and the difference between average improvement and benefits for particular users.

topics.name: Representation Geometry and Interpretable Learning
topics.summary: Representation-focused analyses examine low-rank vision-language alignment, formal models of active perception, rotational matching, neural alignment across minimal solutions, and constraints built from partial dependence. The shared goal is to connect internal geometry or learned interactions with interpretable behavior and reliable transfer.
